answer_1.quote: IUR aims to rewrite an incomplete utterance into an utterance which is semantically equivalent but self-contained to be understood without context.

answer_2.quote: We employ both automatic metrics and human evaluations to evaluate our approach. As in literature , we examine RUN using the widely used automatic metrics BLEU, ROUGE, EM and Rewriting F-score.

answer_4.quote: we fed them to representative IUR models and presented generated rewritten utterances to 10 judges, who are asked to decide which of the rewritten utterances is of higher fluency in pairwise comparisons.
answer_4.guideline: judges decide which of the rewritten utterances is of higher fluency in pairwise comparisons; workers evaluate responses following a multi-scale rating from 0 to 2: 0 means the response is not related to the dialogue; 1 means the response is related but not interesting enough; and 2 means the response is satisfying.
